annotations.title: Find performers available on a date

description: GigXchange artists and bands open to a booking on a specific date. FREE-BY-DEFAULT: a member is bookable on every date EXCEPT ones they have marked (unavailable / on hold / already booked), so a large result means "nobody has blocked that day", not "everyone confirmed they are free"; it is not a confirmed yes. Each result carries the member `id` needed by make_offer and check_member_availability. Filter by city. act_type must be one of: solo, duo, trio, band. Paginated.

act_type.description: Optional act size filter. Exactly one of: solo, duo, trio, band. Anything else is rejected; DJs and other act kinds are found by genre.

city.description: UK city/town to filter by. Omit for national.
